Lamellaphone , with backrest made from two pieces of cane.  The bridge is a tall narrow piece of cane held upright by pins at both side in three places. There were originally 12 tongues.  The bar is attached to the board by vegetable fibre tied through between each tongue. [HLR]

Lamellaphone Box resonator of light coloured wood. The backrest is made from two strips of ?leather. The bar and the strips fastening it between each tongue is of creeper? The C-shaped iron bridge is held in place by the bar and secured by red resin in the front. Tongues have buzzers made from blue glass beads. There is a square hole in the base of the resonator. On the back side the box is cut away to the back plate. In the hollow part there is a small hole on the left side of the back. The right side has a piece sealed in with red resin. The box must have been hollowed out through this hole? [HLR]
